quiz_mappings.original_question: Why does the retrieval client run a BM25 pass and a citation graph pass?
quiz_mappings.chinese_question: 为什么做BM25与引文图两遍检索？
quiz_mappings.answer_reason: 词汇匹配与文献邻接互补；两者都受语料覆盖限制，图还需有效seed/anchor，不自动找到所有基础论文。
quiz_mappings.formal_file: LLM 工程实践/06-评测与实验管理.md

quiz_mappings.original_question: Why is the citation graph traversal capped at two hops?
quiz_mappings.chinese_question: 为什么课程将遍历限制为两跳？
quiz_mappings.answer_reason: 控制候选规模和主题漂移的配置；不是Python限制或普遍研究上限，应另设节点/边/时间预算并核相关性。
quiz_mappings.formal_file: LLM 工程实践/06-评测与实验管理.md

quiz_mappings.original_question: What does idf evaluate to for a term that appears in every document?
quiz_mappings.chinese_question: 一个词出现在每篇文档中，idf是多少？
quiz_mappings.answer_reason: 正idf为ln(1+.5/(N+.5))，为正且大N趋小；N=1约.28768，不能答恰为0。
quiz_mappings.formal_file: LLM 工程实践/06-评测与实验管理.md

quiz_mappings.original_question: Which keys does the merge step use to dedup hits from the two passes?
quiz_mappings.answer_reason: 稳定文献实体ID，但先核命名空间、DOI/预印本与版本关系；标题/年份不能唯一识别，合成p001不证明跨平台归一。
quiz_mappings.formal_file: LLM 工程实践/06-评测与实验管理.md

quiz_mappings.original_question: What does graph_score return for a paper that is two hops from the seed set?
quiz_mappings.answer_reason: 来源默认.3，仅是排序特征；无权BFS取最短hop，不是真实性或30%相关概率。
quiz_mappings.formal_file: LLM 工程实践/06-评测与实验管理.md

quiz_mappings.original_question: Why is the corpus loaded once into a RetrievalClient instead of refetched per query?
quiz_mappings.chinese_question: 为什么语料只加载一次？
quiz_mappings.answer_reason: 索引和图可在固定快照上复用降低重建成本；语料/Tokenizer变化需失效，源码并未真实调用双API合并。
quiz_mappings.formal_file: LLM 工程实践/06-评测与实验管理.md

quiz_mappings.original_question: Why does the runner spawn a subprocess instead of importing the experiment script in process?
quiz_mappings.chinese_question: 为什么起子进程而非直接import实验？
quiz_mappings.answer_reason: 隔地址空间/崩溃并提供终止句柄；文件、网络、凭据和子孙进程权限仍需另限制，不能称安全沙箱。
quiz_mappings.formal_file: LLM 工程实践/06-评测与实验管理.md

quiz_mappings.original_question: Why is the memory cap described as soft?
quiz_mappings.answer_reason: 非内核强限而是间隔轮询，短峰可漏；不支持采集需显式政策，主pid也不覆盖整棵树或显存。
quiz_mappings.formal_file: LLM 工程实践/06-评测与实验管理.md

quiz_mappings.original_question: Which terminal label does the runner return when stdout has the metrics but the exit code is non zero?
quiz_mappings.answer_reason: crash并保存部分指标及日志；出现JSON不等成功，timeout/资源终止保具体原因与时间。
quiz_mappings.formal_file: LLM 工程实践/06-评测与实验管理.md

quiz_mappings.original_question: How does the runner identify the final metrics blob inside stdout?
quiz_mappings.answer_reason: 最后一行能解析且覆盖required keys的JSON，较早行为中间指标；仍须schema/finite/单位/身份/样本校验。
quiz_mappings.formal_file: LLM 工程实践/06-评测与实验管理.md

quiz_mappings.original_question: Why does the ablation helper sweep one knob at a time rather than a full factorial?
quiz_mappings.chinese_question: 为什么helper一次只扫一参数？
quiz_mappings.answer_reason: 条件比较易读且成本较低；不能发现交互，全/部分因子可有明确解释，应按目标和预算选设计。
quiz_mappings.formal_file: LLM 工程实践/06-评测与实验管理.md

quiz_mappings.original_question: What guarantee does forwarding spec.seed into config['__seed'] give the evaluator?
quiz_mappings.answer_reason: 仅传递约定，需要子程序真正使用与核随机源；不能保证wall time相同或单seed证明真实收益。
quiz_mappings.formal_file: LLM 工程实践/06-评测与实验管理.md

quiz_mappings.original_question: Why does the evaluator use a paired t test instead of comparing two single numbers?
quiz_mappings.chinese_question: 为什么不只比较两个单一数值？
quiz_mappings.answer_reason: 多个独立配对差可估均值/SE，seed控制部分条件；仍需差值假设、完整集合和区间，不保证全部噪声取消。
quiz_mappings.formal_file: LLM 工程实践/06-评测与实验管理.md

quiz_mappings.original_question: Why does the evaluator carry a direction field on every metric?
quiz_mappings.answer_reason: accuracy越大越好、loss越小越好，统一改善正号；零基线相对率未知，应另报绝对差。
quiz_mappings.formal_file: LLM 工程实践/06-评测与实验管理.md

quiz_mappings.original_question: What does the verdict path return when |improvement| is below the threshold even if the p value is significant?
quiz_mappings.chinese_question: 显著但小于实际效应阈值怎样处理？
quiz_mappings.answer_reason: 来源叫noise，正式记录“效应未达实际门槛”；统计显著不等值得行动，也不等没效应。
quiz_mappings.formal_file: LLM 工程实践/06-评测与实验管理.md

quiz_mappings.original_question: Why does the evaluator transform log scaled metrics before computing improvement?
quiz_mappings.chinese_question: 为什么PPL转log，是否共享2%阈值？
quiz_mappings.answer_reason: log-PPL对应NLL有解释；原PPL相对差、log绝对差、来源相对log量不同，不能自动共享百分比。
quiz_mappings.formal_file: LLM 工程实践/06-评测与实验管理.md

quiz_mappings.original_question: When does the paired t test helper return p_value = None?
quiz_mappings.answer_reason: n<2缺方差；零SE也是常规t退化，来源对非零恒差设p=0仅程序约定，不能升级成强证据。
quiz_mappings.formal_file: LLM 工程实践/06-评测与实验管理.md

quiz_mappings.original_question: What happens if even one candidate result has a terminal label other than ok?
quiz_mappings.answer_reason: 来源返回failed，基线非ok也同样拦；不选择性删seed，另报完整失败率与不完整原因。
quiz_mappings.formal_file: LLM 工程实践/06-评测与实验管理.md

quiz_mappings.original_question: Why does the writer declare sections, figures, and citations as data before any prose is written?
quiz_mappings.answer_reason: 使结构完整性可校验，但正文支持另核；源码先fill后validate，不能称全部验证在生成前完成。
quiz_mappings.formal_file: LLM 工程实践/06-评测与实验管理.md

quiz_mappings.original_question: What does the figure-injection step produce from an experiment manifest?
quiz_mappings.answer_reason: Figure记录与路径，不是PDF编译；应按明确manifest基准解析并核文件/数据SHA，源进程cwd不能替代。
quiz_mappings.formal_file: LLM 工程实践/06-评测与实验管理.md

quiz_mappings.original_question: Which validation failure raises PaperValidationError before any file is written?
quiz_mappings.answer_reason: 声明引用key未在bibliography等会拦render；源不查图文件存在，正文裸cite/ref与重复section仍有缺口。
quiz_mappings.formal_file: LLM 工程实践/06-评测与实验管理.md

quiz_mappings.original_question: Why is the prose generator a callable injected into PaperWriter rather than a method on it?
quiz_mappings.answer_reason: 便于独立测试writer/生成器与替换接口；真实模型接入后重核副作用、证据、费用与输出格式。
quiz_mappings.formal_file: LLM 工程实践/06-评测与实验管理.md

quiz_mappings.original_question: What three files does PaperWriter.write emit on success?
quiz_mappings.answer_reason: paper.tex、references.bib、manifest.json，没有PDF；顺序三次write非多工件事务。
quiz_mappings.formal_file: LLM 工程实践/06-评测与实验管理.md

quiz_mappings.original_question: Why is the manifest part of the writer's contract instead of just the LaTeX file?
quiz_mappings.answer_reason: 提供机器可读的工件身份和依赖入口；长度/声明key不能证明正文支持、编译或科学质量。

quiz_mappings.original_question: What is the demo's job in this lesson?
quiz_mappings.answer_reason: 组合接口而非基准测试；实际仅加载54–56，50–53为stub，不能称完整科学管线。
quiz_mappings.formal_file: LLM 工程实践/06-评测与实验管理.md

quiz_mappings.original_question: Why does the lesson load earlier lessons via importlib instead of a normal package import?
quiz_mappings.answer_reason: 各课是独立code目录而非已安装package；独立模块名避重名，但仍改sys.path/sys.modules且执行顶层。
quiz_mappings.formal_file: LLM 工程实践/06-评测与实验管理.md

quiz_mappings.original_question: How does the best-result picker decide between branches when more than one triggered a paper?
quiz_mappings.answer_reason: 最高mean reward，同分按branch ID字母序；还需合法同协议、样本数/选择偏差及独立确认，最高不等已证实。
quiz_mappings.formal_file: LLM 工程实践/06-评测与实验管理.md

quiz_mappings.original_question: What error does the picker raise when the scheduler reports zero paper triggers?
quiz_mappings.answer_reason: NoTriggerError阻止继续；全orphan为BestResultError，部分orphan源码静默过滤，不能称所有故障自动短路。
quiz_mappings.formal_file: LLM 工程实践/06-评测与实验管理.md

quiz_mappings.original_question: Why does the demo run twice with the same seed in the determinism test?
quiz_mappings.answer_reason: 原测试仅branch、reward六位精度与section IDs；没有完整工件字节、wall/路径/trace/文献真实性保证。
quiz_mappings.formal_file: LLM 工程实践/06-评测与实验管理.md

quiz_mappings.original_question: What does the demo report contain after a successful run?
quiz_mappings.answer_reason: scheduler_report、best_branch、best_reward、critic_result、paper_manifest、stop_reason；每项仍需stage/证据版本和SHA，生成文件不等科学通过。
